sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Crypto Crush is a match-three puzzle game, where you'll swap and match tokens to clear levels and progress through the game. The game's mechanics are simple yet challenging, with a variety of power-ups, special features, and level objectives that will keep you engaged. Each level is designed to provide a unique challenge, from clearing a certain number of tokens to unlocking new rewards. As you progress through the game, the levels become increasingly difficult, requiring you to think strategically and plan your moves carefully.

The game's token system is also worth mentioning. Each token has its own unique value, with some tokens worth more than others. This adds a whole new level of strategy to the gameplay, as you'll need to balance the value of each token with the need to clear the level. Additionally, the game features a variety of special tokens, such as power-ups, boosters, and bombs, which can be used to clear levels quickly or provide a valuable advantage.

Overall, the gameplay mechanics in Crypto Crush are well-designed, easy to learn, and challenging to master. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a fun way to pass the time, the game's core mechanics will keep you engaged and entertained for hours on end.
